reviewer: Independent bilingual meaning and activity-mechanics reviewer

scope.method: Read the complete exact final candidate, source and functional brief. Rechecked every meaning and mechanics requirement against the final text. Used candidate.authored.json only to verify the claimed text delta. No other reviewer findings or remote services were consulted.
scope.envelope_exclusion: Source edition=test and year=2026 are metadata outside localized segment text; the functional brief does not require them in the candidate envelope.

findings.source_meaning: December is busy; readers can take a short break together.
findings.candidate_wording: W grudniu często jest sporo do zrobienia. Jeśli macie ochotę, możecie zrobić sobie krótką przerwę i pobyć razem.
findings.assessment: The unchanged neighboring unit preserves the December context, general busyness, brevity, togetherness and optional invitation. Często is compatible with the ordinary seasonal generalization. Jeśli macie ochotę makes the existing optionality explicit and does not add an obligation or factual benefit.

findings.source_meaning: A 2-minute sound activity with one quiet starter, subsequent repetition plus one added sound, permission for anyone to pass, restart on loss of order, completion after everyone has had a turn, and literal timer-token retention.
findings.candidate_wording: Przeznaczcie na zabawę 2 minuty. Jedna osoba zaczyna od cichego dźwięku. Każda kolejna osoba powtarza dotychczasowy ciąg dźwięków i dodaje jeden dźwięk. Każdy może pominąć swoją kolej. Jeśli nie pamiętacie już kolejności dźwięków, zacznijcie od nowa. Zakończcie zabawę, gdy każdy będzie już po swojej turze. W etykiecie minutnika zachowajcie dokładny zapis {minutes}.
findings.assessment: All required actions, conditions, counts, permissions and the exact token remain present. The changed phrase po swojej turze expresses the same completed-turn condition as has had a turn and makes the actor/action relationship direct. The cumulative sound wording remains coherent with the supplied brief’s preceding-material and preserved-order requirements. No new precedence between timing and completion, starter-selection method, direction, round, variant, score or penalty appears.
